request  r-0000001  GET /v1/list?prefix=%2Fservices%2F&limit=500  502
error[ZC-E0810]: a certificate is not signed by the pinned anchor
  cause  node2's certificate was refused: its signature does not verify under
         the pinned anchor key
  reqid  r-0000001
  fix    check that both sides use this cluster's CA or the pinned anchor (docs/mtls.md)
  more   zcube explain E0810
  docs   https://zigbox.github.io/zigcube/errors/E0810.html
